cast_scale_bf16_f32.traffic_model: read bf16 (2B) + write f32 (4B) per element
cast_scale_bf16_f32.caveat: this measurement includes the fresh device.alloc::<f32>(n) cost (151 MB output buffer, allocated every call since apply1 has no output-buffer reuse) — NOT a device-side-only kernel timeline; the true kernel-only GB/s is likely higher than this wall-clock-derived figure. 14.89% is below the guide's "realistic 25-50%" band; vectorized 128-bit loads (guide S2 fix #1) were not implemented in this pass — a Wave 1.1 follow-up, not done here due to inability to compile-test CUDA locally (no nvcc on the authoring machine) this close to the timing run.

cast_add_bf16.traffic_model: read f32 (4B) + read bf16 (2B) + write bf16 (2B) per element
cast_add_bf16.caveat: smaller output buffer (25 MB bf16) than cast_scale_bf16_f32's, so less allocation-overhead confound; inside the guide's realistic 25-50% band.
